q: What is the time complexity of building a string of n characters like this?
why: Strings are immutable, so each `+=` can copy the whole string so far. Collect in a list and `"".join` once for O(n).
Splitting on a single space keeps the empty string between the two spaces. `split()` with no argument would give ['a', 'b'].
Digit characters have consecutive codes, so subtracting the code of '0' gives the digit's value.

q: Counting letters of a lowercase string with a 26-slot array uses how much extra space?
why: 26 slots no matter how long the string is: constant space.

q: In a Roman numeral, when is a symbol subtracted?
options: When it's smaller than the symbol right after it
When it's I, X or C anywhere
why: Symbols normally go largest to smallest. A smaller one before a bigger one (IV, XC, CM) counts negatively.
Skip spaces, read '-', read digits 1 and 2, then stop at 'a'. Everything after is ignored.
